subject: Round-3 re-review: FAIL, 2 blocking (escalate)
body: I re-reviewed the round-3 surface (hunks H3.1-H3.4), checked every citation the revision added against the live files and Orca 1.4.245, and ran /sc:spec-panel-diffgate with the Skill tool; the read-only check --dry-run accepted the report with verdict FAIL and halt escalate. The three round-2 blocking findings (R1.3, R2.1, R2.2) are resolved and R2.5 is fixed, but two new blocking findings remain: R3.1, a retry reuses attempt 1's brief, so commands whose resume needs an explicit flag (roadmap, brainstorm, release-split, adversarial, pr-submit, cli-portify) never resume and a roadmap retry overwrites attempt 1's directory (SPEC:64,118,205); and R3.2, AC-0.4 runs step 4's worker_status assertion on P0 reports that lack that field, so all three P0 smoke runs fail (SPEC:183,194). Left: this was review 3 of 3, so the coordinator runs the binding check step and escalates R3.1 and R3.2 to the user; minor notes R3.3, R2.3, R2.4 and C13 stay open.
